data.body: Implemented: materialize()'s populate branch now routes through materialize_via_donor (entry_prefix='', subdir='') before falling back to _materialize_tree, mirroring the bug-8386 tickets fix exactly. RED observed 4.00x (3,200,152 bytes vs one ~800,000-byte tree for 4 adjacent-SHA resolutions); GREEN <2x with unchanged blobs sharing one inode. New test test_adjacent_code_shas_reuse_unchanged_blobs also re-verifies each entry byte-matches git ls-tree at its own SHA (attestation basis: sharing is fail-closed, faithfulness unchanged; LFS/submodule caveats unaffected — a tree with gitlinks/symlinks falls back to full build, and caveat detection runs on the built entry regardless of path). Two janitor tests updated: the concurrent-accounting settle assertion now compares against the distinct-inode walk (entries now share), and the max_bytes-cap LRU test uses disjoint entries so 'newest survives' stays well-defined; shared-entry cap semantics remain pinned by the 8386 tests. Gates: lint/typecheck/complexity all green; 511 snapshot/cache tests pass.
